'''Downtown Plaza''' was an expansive outdoor area of the most upper levels of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] flew above this area upon being granted permission to land on [[Platform 327/Legends|Platform 327]].<ref name="TESB" /><ref name="CCGlight">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Cloud City: Downtown Plaza (Light)}}</ref> Revelers could be seen rejoicing in the plaza following news of the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="CCGdark">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Cloud City: Downtown Plaza (Dark)}}</ref>
